help.importInstalledIntro: Register many installed rims of {{productName}} at once: Serial Number, Vehicle Registration and Position Code per row.
help.importNewStockIntro: Register many New Stock rims of {{productName}} at once: Serial Number and Warehouse Code per row.
help.legacyCatalog_one: {{count}} rim is recorded in the earlier Rim catalog.
help.legacyCatalog_other: {{count}} rims are recorded in the earlier Rim catalog.
help.legacyCatalogPage: Records of the earlier standalone Rim catalog. New rims are Rim Products (Tire Management → Rim) with serial-numbered rims.
help.noWheelConfiguration: This vehicle has no Wheels Configuration yet; assign one in Vehicle Details first.
help.positionFromConfiguration: Positions come from the vehicle's Wheels Configuration. A tire on the same position is not affected.
help.productDeleted: This product was deleted. Its rims and their history stay visible; no new rims can be added.
help.registerFor: Register a serial-numbered rim of {{productName}}. Most rims are already on vehicles: register them as Installed on their wheel position.

import.helpPositionCode: Wheel position code from the vehicle's Wheels Configuration (e.g. FL, FR, RLO).
import.helpSerialNumber: The serial number of the physical rim, at most 100 characters. Unique in your company.
import.helpVehicleRegistration: Registration number of the vehicle the rim is on (spaces and letter case are ignored).
import.helpWarehouseCode: Code of the warehouse the rim is stored in (Organization → Warehouses).
import.positionRepeatedInFile: Position {{position}} of {{vehicle}} is repeated in the file (first on row {{row}}).
import.ruleNewStock: Imported rims are registered as New Stock, without a vehicle.
import.rulePosition: The position must be a position of that Wheels Configuration without an installed rim, and each vehicle + position may appear only once in the file.
import.ruleProduct: Every row is a rim of product {{productName}}; the specification comes from the product.
import.ruleSerialUnique: A serial number may be registered only once in your company (letter case and surrounding spaces are ignored) and only once in the file.
import.ruleTireCoexists: A tire installed on the same position is not affected: a position holds a tire and a rim.
import.ruleVehicle: The vehicle must exist, be inside your data scope and have a Wheels Configuration.
